AboutPage.founderPhotoAlt: Portrait of Armel BOUGMA, founder of Taloom

AboutPage.story: In Lille and Abidjan, I support small businesses, startups, schools and non-profits that need a serious contact able to scope, build and support a digital project without unnecessary jargon.
AboutPage.storySecond: Work always starts from the real need: understand the business, write the scope, choose a proportionate architecture and deliver something useful. Everything else — technology, tools, method — serves that outcome.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy policy
PrivacyPage.intro: The site collects and processes information only as part of the business relationship and initial contact.
PrivacyPage.dataText: Information sent through the contact form includes name, email address, company or organisation, project type and message. This data is used only to answer the request.
PrivacyPage.usageText: Information is used to scope the need, prepare a response or proposal and organise a useful conversation. It is not sold or shared with third parties without professional necessity.
PrivacyPage.rightsText: Data subjects may request access, correction or deletion of their information. Retention periods, processors and GDPR contact details must be completed before production release.

reasons.difficulte: The project is in difficulty: an audit identifies the causes before new work is committed.
reasons.conseil: The request calls for a technical opinion: a focused audit clarifies options and risks.
reasons.reprendre: Taking over an existing system first requires understanding its real state, dependencies and breaking points.
reasons.ia: An AI use case must be governed: prototype, quality measurement, costs and safeguards before integration.
reasons.automatiser: The goal is to automate a task: a measurable scope and human validation are defined before production.
reasons.cloud: The need is infrastructure-related: containers, deployment, backups and monitoring are treated as a foundation.
reasons.fiabiliser: The existing system must be stabilised: priorities are stability, monitoring and reversible releases.
reasons.api: The project exposes data or services: the API contract, security and tests come first.
reasons.existant: A product already exists: the approach favours incremental delivery without breaking live journeys.
reasons.idee: The need is still an idea: a short scoping phase sets the problem, scope and success criteria.
reasons.formation: The goal includes knowledge transfer: scoping and explicit working formats are set from the start.
reasons.budgetLimite: The budget is constrained: tight scoping helps choose a first genuinely useful scope.
reasons.plateforme: The project is an application with broad ambition: a scalable platform avoids rebuilding the foundation at every step.
reasons.delai: The deadline is tight: a prioritised MVP focuses effort on essential journeys.
reasons.siteVendre: The site must sell: an MVP focused on the message, contact journeys and measurement is preferred.
reasons.appCadre: The application need is scoped: an MVP delivers essential journeys and allows later adjustment.
reasons.siteCadre: The site need is scoped: an MVP delivers a useful, measurable first version.
reasons.fallback: The answers do not trigger a specific rule: short scoping helps clarify the need.
